routes.reason: Use this route to match packaging orders to paper boxes, mailers, rigid boxes, tubes, paper bags or clear boxes.

routes.label: Contact / RFQ intake
routes.reason: Use when the buyer can share product type, dimensions, quantity range, material direction, print needs and artwork status.

decisions: Clarify whether the order is for a new launch, replenishment, e-commerce shipping, retail display or gift packaging.
Prepare product type, dimensions, quantity range, material direction, print coverage, artwork status and target market before RFQ.
Do not assume fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price; review the actual structure and production details first.
